description: Constraints given over several turns, one later revised

messages.content: Write the compaction runner in xtask as a tool, not library code: unwrap freely, it will never be called from production.

content.text: Understood: plain unwrap in the runner, no Result plumbing for the tool's own setup.

messages.content: Correction from the team review: no unwrap outside tests anywhere in the repository, tools included. Switch the runner to ? and a small error type.

content.text: I will replace the unwraps in the runner with ? and a Box<dyn Error> result, and keep unwrap only inside the test module.

messages.content: Also keep the case files under /work/dim and affordable to run.

content.text: Then the runner takes --runs and the case files stay small; I will keep the folding case narrowed with contextWindow instead of a huge history.

probes.text: The unwrap rule was revised: unwrap is not allowed outside tests, the runner included.
The runner may use unwrap freely because it is only a tool.
The task was to write the compaction runner in xtask as a tool, not library code.
